==Summary==

{{pov|[[Seaine Herimon]]}}

The prologue opens up to a basement in the White Tower where [[Pevara Tazanovni]], [[Seaine Herimon]], [[Saerin Asnobar]], [[Doesine Alwain]] and [[Yukiri Haruna]] are performing a ritual on an Aes Sedai. The ritual is normally used on criminals to make them confess to their crimes and repent. A ''ter'angreal'' is used for this, the [[Chair of Remorse]]. Yukiri worries that they will be removed as Sitters, and probably worse since they are forbidden to use the Chair on initiates of the White Tower.

At the end of the ritual, [[Talene Minly]] is made to renounce her previous oaths and re-swear the three oaths along with the "new fourth oath" to obey the five sisters present. She is then questioned and reveals she is [[Black Ajah]]. She declares that [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]] is also Black Ajah but provides no actual proof. She says that their group always knows every order before it's been given so she asks what else could be the answer other than Elaida being Black Ajah. The rest of the group is not convinced.

{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}

[[Elayne Trakand]] is in her sitting room with [[Birgitte Trahelion]] and [[Dyelin Taravin]], discussing the current state of things and Elayne's plans for the future. Birgitte lets slip a piece of her past in front of Dyelin when Elayne orders her to make an army good enough to withstand ten houses. They are interrupted by the [[Sea Folk]] [[Renaile din Calon Blue Star]], [[Zaida din Parede Blackwing]], and [[Merilille]]. The [[windfinders]] are badgering Elayne for more teachers to fulfill their bargain. Shortly after an agreement is made for sisters in the Palace to do some teaching, [[Reene Harfor]] announces [[Mazrim Taim]] who enters unceremoniously with two [[Asha'man]] and presents his own demands on Elayne's time and land. Just as Elayne is setting him straight, the [[Wise One]], [[Nadere]] enters to call Elayne away.

Elayne needs to answer the summons immediately and without hesitation. She also needs to answer it "as a child comes to birth."

She is told to strip in front of all present. As Elayne complies much to her embarrassment, Taim gives the Asha'man present the order "about face." Several of the ladies present attempt to form a wall between Elayne and Taim (who admires Elayne's hips over his shoulder). After she strips naked, and leaves the room with nothing but a shawl to guard against the cold, she is brought to a room with half a dozen Wise Ones and the [[Bonding|birthing ceremony]] where she and Aviendha become [[first-sister]]s commences. 

The ceremony is a ritual involving surrogate mothers for each Elayne ([[Viendre]]) and Aviendha ([[Tamela]]) as well as a third surrogate mother to "suffer the pangs of birth." [[Amys]] serves the last role. Wise Ones weave [[Saidar]] and [[Monaelle]], acting as an officiant, asks Elayne and Aviendha a series of questions to be answered with complete honesty about each other and then directs the women to slap each other. The resolve to become first-sisters not shattered by the honesty and pain inflicted, Elayne experiences a simulated gestation as a fetus through birth, sensing Aviendha along side her for the experience.

Elayne notices more than a kinship with Aviendha after the rebirth. She senses a psychic link not unlike her bond with her [[Warder]] but fainter.

{{pov|[[Toveine Gazal]]}}

[[Toveine Gazal]] and [[Gabrelle Brawley]] Sedai are bound to [[Logain Ablar]] by the warder bond. She watches a group walk through the village area, not realizing Mazrim Taim is escorting Elayne and Birgitte until one of the ''Asha'man'' calls her Lady Elayne. She has orders to hide her face from outsiders so none will know she is Aes Sedai. 

Toveine learns that Gabrelle is sleeping with Logain and is disgusted by it. Gabrelle explains she was using it to extract information from Logain and begins sharing all she learned. Apparently, Logain is the only full ''Asha'man'' in this village while all others are with Taim in his "palace." After reading through Toveine's papers, including Elaida's orders to gentle and hang all male channelers on the spot, he burned them in an effort to protect them. Toveine overhears that Taim has declared several ''Asha'man'' as deserters and some of them are said to have been faithful to Taim. The Black Tower had already begun separating into one faction for Taim and another faction for Logain. Now that their attack on the Black Tower failed, they decide to unite under [[Desandre Alraed]] as the only way to keep the 51 captured Aes Sedai together.

{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

Rand and Min are in the Academy at Cairhien so she can get some books from [[Herid Fel|Master Fel]]'s old library. He has apparently been jumping around the world trying to throw various people off his trail and lead others into a trap. [[Dobraine]] reports on what is happening at the Sun Palace and [[Idrien Tarsin]] reports on the various strange inventions being made at the Academy. After they leave Rand tells Min what his real plan is, to cleanse the taint from ''saidin''. Rand is carrying both of the [[Choedan Kal]] access keys with him; he plans to use them, but one will need a woman channeler.

==Miscellaneous==
The weave used during the first sisters ceremony to hold the words of Aviendha and Elayne is potentially similar to a weave that could be used to avoid the three oaths by black sisters.{{verify}}
